The success of the 'Anti-Bias Configuration' (SRC_005) is dependent on the 'Skeptic Validation' (SRC_004) because logging negative results is only useful if there is a mechanism to treat them as valid data points rather than errors; without the skeptic layer's philosophical framework that values non-replication and null results, the UI configuration alone fails to change stakeholder behavior. REFUTED IF stakeholders naturally value and act upon negative results displayed in the dashboard without needing the underlying epistemic justification provided by the skeptic stance.
